text:
sam: DSAR came in for user@example.com — they want account + all embeddings removed from staging. Staging has nightly snapshots; need safe steps for keystore-wrapped blobs. cc @nina

maya: Do we treat staging like prod for erasure? Legal usually expects removal of personal data even in non-prod. :eyes:

liam: Two likely places: vector DB snapshots in s3 and embeddings stored as ciphertext in GCS buckets. Both use the staging CMEK: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/staging/cryptoKeys/stage-key.

security-bot: Quick checklist: 1) Confirm identifier in DSAR 2) Search index + metadata 3) Locate candidate snapshots 4) Gather KMS audit logs. I'll enqueue the search job.

ops-bot: Search job started: `/ops-search --env=staging --q "user:email:user@example.com"` (job id 48237). ETA ~6m.

maya: If the KMS key rotates later, can we still produce deletion proof? Legal will want evidence of decrypt attempts and deletes tied to the request.

liam: We export Cloud Audit Logs -> BigQuery. Unwrap/decrypt logs live there. But older provider-managed snapshots may still hold ciphertext. Practical erasure: remove active records + schedule secure purge of older snapshots and mark as deleted in metadata.

nina: Legal: we need an evidence bundle showing accessible copies were removed and a retention-exception plan for archived backups. We can't just nuke provider immutable snapshots without sign-off. Need infra purge window and approval chain.

alex: Proposed flow (short):
1) Freeze user queries / isolate account
2) Remove vectors from live index + reindex affected shard
3) Revoke decrypt-capable service accounts (temporary)
4) Submit snapshot purge request to infra with ticket + justification
5) Produce deletion evidence bundle (audit logs + object hashes + job ids)

sam: RBAC question — who can approve staging snapshot purge today? My understanding: infra-admins + security-leads. We shouldn't be manually elevating people in the moment.

liam: Agree. Don't change long-lived roles ad-hoc. Suggest creating a short-lived role `erase-approver-staging` scoped to `storage.objects.delete` + `compute.snapshots.delete` for 1h and require an iam-ticket. Ops can issue for verified requests only.

ops: I can provision a time-bound role via our iam workflow. Need ticket number, owner, and TTL. Note: we cannot destruct KMS keys; deletion is removal of ciphertext and entries, not key destruction.

nina: Confirming: legal requires KMS audit entries (principal, method, timestamp), snapshot purge job id, and a signed statement from infra that objects were deleted or scheduled for secure purge. Ephemeral-role approach sounds fine.

alex: Adding to checklist vars for the evidence bundle: `kmsKeyName`, `ciphertextObject`, `objectHash`, `auditLogEntries` (export path), `purgeJobId`.

sam: I'll open the iam-ticket and infra purge request now. filing: iam/7892 + purge/7893. Also adding a minimization check in Redwood Optimize to surface any downstream regressions if embeddings removal affects quality.

ops-bot: jobs created: search=48237, purge-request=7893. Watch channel for updates. :white_check_mark:

sam: Thanks everyone — proceeding with ticket flow. If infra needs a formal legal sign-off, @nina please comment on purge/7893 once you have the evidence requirements attached.

nina: Will do, ping me when evidence bundle is ready.
